entries.en: The prank succeeded because of his credulity about anything he read online.
entries.zh: 这场恶作剧得逞，是因为他轻信网上读到的任何东西。

entries.en: She wrote copiously in her notebook throughout the long train journey.
entries.zh: 在漫长的火车旅途中，她一直在笔记本上写个不停。

entries.en: The archaeologists discovered funerary objects beside the entrance to the tomb.
entries.zh: 考古学家在墓穴入口旁发现了丧葬用品。

entries.meaningZh: 未列入计划的；不定期的
entries.en: An unscheduled stop gave us time to photograph the mountain lake.
entries.zh: 一次计划外的停留让我们有时间拍摄那个高山湖泊。

entries.en: The students compared the samples quantitatively using their measured masses.
entries.zh: 学生们利用测得的质量，对样本进行了定量比较。

entries.en: His suntan had faded by the time the holiday photographs arrived.
entries.zh: 假期照片寄到时，他晒黑的肤色已经褪了。

entries.en: In the novel, parliament votes to legalise the previously banned trade.
entries.zh: 在这部小说中，议会投票决定使先前被禁止的交易合法化。

entries.en: Waterborne cargo arrived at the harbor before the roads reopened.
entries.zh: 道路重新开放前，水运货物就已抵达港口。

entries.en: A single footfall echoed through the empty corridor behind us.
entries.zh: 我们身后空荡荡的走廊里响起了一声脚步声。

entries.en: The humourless official stared silently at our attempts to make conversation.
entries.zh: 那位缺乏幽默感的官员默默盯着我们，对我们试图攀谈的举动毫无回应。

entries.en: The gardener moved the delicate orchids into the hothouse before winter.
entries.zh: 入冬前，园丁把娇嫩的兰花搬进了温室。

entries.en: The unexpected award gave a welcome fillip to the theater's fundraising campaign.
entries.zh: 这个意外获得的奖项为剧院的募款活动带来了可喜的推动。

entries.en: They spent a week crossing the outback in a dusty four-wheel-drive vehicle.
entries.zh: 他们开着一辆满是灰尘的四驱车，用一周时间穿越了澳大利亚偏远内陆。

entries.en: The vehemence of her objection surprised everyone at the planning meeting.
entries.zh: 在规划会议上，她反对得如此激烈，让所有人都很吃惊。

entries.en: The suddenness of the thunderclap made the sleeping cat leap up.
entries.zh: 突如其来的雷声让熟睡的猫一下跳了起来。

entries.en: Each participant rated the paintings subjectively before discussing their choices.
entries.zh: 每位参与者先主观地给画作评分，然后讨论自己的选择。

entries.en: She emptied a sachet of sugar into her coffee and stirred.
entries.zh: 她把一小袋糖倒进咖啡里，搅了搅。

entries.en: The farmer's diary records a stillborn lamb during the harsh winter.
entries.zh: 农夫的日记记载，那个严冬里有一只小羊出生时已经死亡。

entries.en: An experienced mountaineer led the group across the snowy ridge.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的登山者带领队伍越过了积雪的山脊。

entries.en: The newspaper printed a retraction after discovering that its report was false.
entries.zh: 发现报道失实后，报纸刊登了撤回声明。

entries.en: The university library keeps gynaecological journals beside the other medical periodicals.
entries.zh: 大学图书馆把妇科期刊放在其他医学期刊旁边。

entries.en: This is indisputably the oldest surviving building in the village.
entries.zh: 这无疑是村里现存最古老的建筑。

entries.meaningZh: 法寻；旧时四分之一便士硬币
entries.en: The old farthing lay among several coins in the museum drawer.
entries.zh: 那枚旧的四分之一便士硬币与几枚其他硬币一起放在博物馆抽屉里。

entries.en: The baby was an enthusiastic creeper long before she learned to walk.
entries.zh: 这个宝宝早在学会走路之前，就已经是个喜欢到处爬的小家伙了。

entries.en: A broken castor made the office chair wobble whenever he moved.
entries.zh: 一个坏掉的脚轮让办公椅在他一动时就晃来晃去。

entries.en: The bursary helped her cover travel costs during her final year.
entries.zh: 这笔助学金帮她支付了最后一学年的交通费用。

entries.en: The weather looks iffy, so the picnic may move indoors.
entries.zh: 天气看起来不太稳，野餐可能要改到室内。

entries.en: She looked through the peephole before opening the apartment door.
entries.zh: 她打开公寓门之前，先从猫眼向外看了看。

entries.en: Stone urns stood at intervals along the terrace's ornate balustrade.
entries.zh: 露台华丽的栏杆上，每隔一段就放着一个石瓮。

entries.en: The plan seemed insanely ambitious for a team of only three volunteers.
entries.zh: 对一个只有三名志愿者的团队来说，这个计划雄心大得有些疯狂。

entries.en: The artificiality of his smile made the friendly greeting seem rehearsed.
entries.zh: 他的笑容太不自然，让友好的问候也像事先排练过一样。

entries.en: She grinned wickedly before revealing where she had hidden the cookies.
entries.zh: 她顽皮地咧嘴一笑，才说出把饼干藏在了哪里。

entries.en: The robot sent back clear images of rocks on the seafloor.
entries.zh: 机器人传回了海底岩石的清晰图像。

entries.en: In the comedy, the thieves accidentally leave their swag on the bus.
entries.zh: 在这部喜剧中，小偷们不小心把赃物落在了公交车上。

entries.en: The newsreader paused briefly before introducing the report from the harbor.
entries.zh: 新闻播音员略作停顿后，开始介绍来自港口的报道。

entries.en: The restaurant served a forgettable meal in an otherwise beautiful setting.
entries.zh: 餐厅的环境很美，但饭菜平淡无奇，难以留下印象。

entries.en: She read by lamplight while rain tapped against the dark window.
entries.zh: 雨点敲打着漆黑的窗户，她在灯光下读书。

entries.en: The memoir condemns the inhumanity of the prison system it describes.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录谴责了书中所描述的监狱制度的残暴。

entries.en: The children cut glittery stars from silver paper for the classroom ceiling.
entries.zh: 孩子们用银色纸剪出闪亮的星星，装饰教室天花板。

entries.en: These two cables can be used interchangeably with the same speaker.
entries.zh: 这两根电缆可以互换，都能用于同一个扬声器。

entries.en: The spy novel follows a counterintelligence officer investigating a mysterious leak.
entries.zh: 这部间谍小说讲述一名反情报人员调查一起神秘泄密事件的故事。

entries.en: The baker shooed the pigeons away from the café's outdoor tables.
entries.zh: 面包师嘘声赶走了咖啡馆露天桌旁的鸽子。

entries.en: The historian traced a connexion between the two families through their letters.
entries.zh: 历史学家通过两家的书信查出了他们之间的联系。

entries.en: Goddammit, the printer has swallowed the last sheet of paper again!
entries.zh: 该死，打印机又把最后一张纸卡住了！

entries.en: She folded the towels tidily and stacked them inside the cupboard.
entries.zh: 她把毛巾叠得整整齐齐，放进了柜子里。

entries.en: The diagram shows a tangent touching the circle at one point.
entries.zh: 图中显示，一条切线在一点与圆相切。

entries.en: The museum exhibit explained how researchers studied tetanus in the nineteenth century.
entries.zh: 博物馆展览介绍了十九世纪的研究者如何研究破伤风。

entries.en: The historian analyzed posters produced by a propagandist during the war.
entries.zh: 历史学家分析了一位宣传者在战争期间制作的海报。

entries.en: A small green shamrock was embroidered on the pocket of his jacket.
entries.zh: 他的夹克口袋上绣着一棵小小的绿色三叶草。

entries.en: The crew began to offload crates as soon as the ship docked.
entries.zh: 船一靠岸，船员们就开始卸下货箱。

entries.en: The child mischievously swapped the name cards before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到达之前，那个孩子淘气地调换了姓名卡。

entries.meaningZh: 因身体或其他原因无法外出的
entries.en: Volunteers delivered library books to housebound residents throughout the winter.
entries.zh: 整个冬天，志愿者们都给无法外出的居民送图书馆的书。

entries.en: We bought hot coffee from a small dockside café before boarding.
entries.zh: 上船前，我们在一家码头边的小咖啡馆买了热咖啡。

entries.en: The inspector inserted a grain trier into the sack to collect a sample.
entries.zh: 检查员把谷物取样器插进袋子里，采集了一份样本。

entries.en: The researchers drilled into the permafrost to study layers of ancient soil.
entries.zh: 研究者钻入永久冻土，研究古老的土层。

entries.en: The team won three matches consecutively before losing the final.
entries.zh: 球队连续赢了三场比赛，随后在决赛中落败。

entries.en: The clerk brusquely told us to join the queue by the window.
entries.zh: 职员粗声粗气地让我们到窗口旁排队。

entries.en: The emcee welcomed the audience and introduced the evening's first performer.
entries.zh: 主持人欢迎观众，并介绍了当晚第一位表演者。

entries.en: The cave's discoverer returned years later to help map its hidden chambers.
entries.zh: 洞穴的发现者多年后再次回来，帮助绘制那些隐秘洞室的地图。

entries.en: The dancers moved through the courtyard in the flickering torchlight.
entries.zh: 舞者们在摇曳的火炬光中穿过庭院。

entries.en: The harbor's records list the tonnage of cargo handled each month.
entries.zh: 港口记录列出了每月装卸货物的吨数。

entries.en: Her workroom smelled of fresh wood and held tools of every size.
entries.zh: 她的工作室里有新木头的气味，放着各种尺寸的工具。

entries.en: The character's shifty manner made the detective question his friendly story.
entries.zh: 这个人物鬼鬼祟祟的样子，让侦探对他那番亲切的说辞产生了怀疑。

entries.en: The rediscovery of the old path made the village accessible again.
entries.zh: 重新发现那条旧路后，村庄又能通行了。

entries.en: The school group toured the statehouse and sat in its public gallery.
entries.zh: 学校参观团游览了州议会大厦，并在公众旁听席上坐了坐。

entries.en: A pink piglet squeezed through the fence and followed us across the yard.
entries.zh: 一只粉红色小猪挤过栅栏，跟着我们穿过院子。

entries.en: A teeny crack near the handle was the cup's only flaw.
entries.zh: 杯柄附近一条极小的裂纹，是这个杯子唯一的瑕疵。

entries.en: The lamb bleated softly until its mother returned to the pen.
entries.zh: 小羊轻轻地咩咩叫着，直到母羊回到圈里。

entries.en: The ground felt squishy under our boots after the overnight rain.
entries.zh: 下了一夜雨后，靴子下的地面踩起来湿软湿软的。

entries.en: She chose cardiology as the subject of her medical history presentation.
entries.zh: 她选择心脏病学作为医学史报告的主题。

entries.en: The loose sign swung crazily above the shop's doorway in the wind.
entries.zh: 风中，松动的招牌在店门上方摇晃得厉害。

entries.en: The baby dropped her pacifier onto the blanket beside the cot.
entries.zh: 宝宝把安抚奶嘴掉在了婴儿床旁的毯子上。

entries.en: An outdated sign misdirected several visitors toward the closed museum entrance.
entries.zh: 一块过时的指示牌把几位游客误导到了已关闭的博物馆入口。

entries.en: The workshop encouraged innovatory approaches to designing furniture for small rooms.
entries.zh: 工作坊鼓励大家用创新方法为小房间设计家具。

entries.en: In the novel, the guards trounce a prisoner for refusing to kneel.
entries.zh: 在小说中，守卫们因一名囚犯不肯下跪而痛打了他。

entries.en: She and her hubby run the little bakery beside the station.
entries.zh: 她和老公经营着车站旁的那家小面包店。

entries.en: The hikers ate hungrily after their long climb through the forest.
entries.zh: 徒步者们在林中长途攀爬后，饥肠辘辘地大口吃了起来。

entries.en: The advertisement overplays the differences between this model and the previous one.
entries.zh: 这则广告夸大了这款型号与上一款之间的差异。

entries.meaningZh: 无法证明正当的；不合理的
entries.en: The committee considered the destruction of the old trees unjustifiable.
entries.zh: 委员会认为，毁掉这些老树没有正当理由。

entries.en: The choir sang a joyful hallelujah at the end of the service.
entries.zh: 礼拜结束时，唱诗班唱了一首欢快的赞美上帝的颂歌。

entries.en: The restorer carefully removed layers of dirt from the old portrait.
entries.zh: 修复师小心地清除了旧肖像画上层层的污垢。

entries.en: The children left their mucky boots outside the clean kitchen.
entries.zh: 孩子们把脏兮兮的靴子留在了干净的厨房外。

entries.en: Warm light glowed seductively through the café's windows on the rainy evening.
entries.zh: 那个雨夜，温暖的灯光从咖啡馆窗户里透出来，十分诱人。

entries.en: The tiny office felt airless after everyone crowded inside for the meeting.
entries.zh: 大家挤进小办公室开会后，里面显得闷不透气。

entries.meaningZh: 一公共汽车所载的人数或数量
entries.en: A busload of tourists arrived just as the museum opened.
entries.zh: 博物馆刚开门，一满车的游客就到了。

entries.en: He handed me a tenner to cover the cost of lunch.
entries.zh: 他递给我一张十英镑纸币，用来付午餐的钱。

entries.en: She chose a glam silver jacket for the band's final performance.
entries.zh: 她为乐队的最后一场演出选了一件华丽的银色外套。

entries.en: The exhibition captures the optimistic zeitgeist of the city's early television era.
entries.zh: 这场展览捕捉到了这座城市电视发展初期乐观的时代精神。

entries.en: The manager decided to redeploy two volunteers to the crowded entrance.
entries.zh: 经理决定把两名志愿者调到拥挤的入口处。

entries.en: The documentary interviews a gynaecologist about her work at the hospital.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片采访了一位妇科医生，介绍她在医院的工作。

entries.en: The two branches remain operationally independent despite using the same name.
entries.zh: 这两个分支虽然使用同一名称，但在运作上仍相互独立。

entries.en: The museum model showed a caveman shaping a tool beside a fire.
entries.zh: 博物馆模型展示了一位穴居人在火边制作工具。

entries.en: The dental model showed tartar on the surfaces of several teeth.
entries.zh: 这个牙齿模型展示了几颗牙齿表面的牙结石。

entries.en: The society donated books in furtherance of its aim to encourage reading.
entries.zh: 协会捐赠了书籍，以推进其鼓励阅读的目标。

entries.en: The visitors received an effusive welcome from their hosts at the station.
entries.zh: 客人们在车站受到主人们热情洋溢的欢迎。

entries.en: The critic discussed the subtle eroticism in the painter's later portraits.
entries.zh: 评论家讨论了这位画家晚期肖像画中含蓄的情色意味。

entries.en: The council's conservancy work helped preserve the woodland beside the river.
entries.zh: 议会的保护工作帮助保存了河边的林地。

entries.en: The costume gave the actor a softer, more womanly silhouette.
entries.zh: 这套服装让演员的轮廓更柔和，也更具女性气质。

entries.en: The singer switched to a clear falsetto for the final phrase.
entries.zh: 歌手在最后一个乐句转用了清亮的假声。

entries.en: The ubiquity of smartphones has changed how tourists navigate unfamiliar cities.
entries.zh: 智能手机的普及改变了游客在陌生城市中辨认方向的方式。

entries.en: The audience gasped at the dancer's acrobatic leap across the stage.
entries.zh: 舞者以杂技般的动作跃过舞台，观众发出了惊叹。

entries.en: The little girl asked whether she could stroke the sleepy doggie.
entries.zh: 小女孩问，她可不可以摸摸那只困倦的狗狗。

entries.en: The congregation gathered in the wooden tabernacle for the evening service.
entries.zh: 会众聚集在木制礼拜堂里，参加晚间礼拜。

entries.en: The crew fought valiantly to keep the damaged boat afloat.
entries.zh: 船员们勇敢地奋力抢救，让受损的船继续浮在水面上。

entries.en: The old steamship carried passengers across the lake for nearly fifty years.
entries.zh: 那艘老蒸汽轮船曾在这个湖上运送乘客近五十年。

entries.en: He brazenly denied breaking the vase despite holding its missing handle.
entries.zh: 尽管手里还拿着花瓶缺失的把手，他仍厚颜无耻地否认打碎了它。

entries.en: The pale walls and wooden furniture blended harmoniously with the garden view.
entries.zh: 浅色墙面和木制家具与花园景色和谐地融为一体。

entries.en: She courageously admitted her mistake in front of the entire team.
entries.zh: 她勇敢地当着整个团队的面承认了自己的错误。

entries.en: A lynx stepped silently through the snow beneath the dark pine trees.
entries.zh: 一只猞猁悄无声息地踏过深色松树下的积雪。

entries.en: The outdoor rehearsal was unavoidably delayed by a sudden hailstorm.
entries.zh: 一场突如其来的冰雹使户外排练不可避免地推迟了。

entries.en: She dealt straightforwardly with her colleagues and never concealed important information.
entries.zh: 她坦诚地与同事相处，从不隐瞒重要信息。

entries.en: The adventure novel's hero loses a boot while struggling out of quicksand.
entries.zh: 这部冒险小说的主人公挣扎着逃出流沙时，丢了一只靴子。

entries.meaningZh: 饲养的野生动物群；动物园
entries.en: The palace once housed a menagerie of exotic birds and animals.
entries.zh: 这座宫殿曾经饲养着一群珍奇的鸟兽。

entries.en: The glass prism refracts the beam into bands of different colors.
entries.zh: 玻璃棱镜使光束折射，分成不同颜色的光带。

entries.en: We served tortilla chips with fresh guacamole and a bowl of salsa.
entries.zh: 我们端上玉米片，配着新鲜的牛油果酱和一碗萨尔萨酱。

entries.en: The film portrays a fictional killer whose psychopathic behavior disturbs the detective.
entries.zh: 电影描绘了一名虚构的杀手，他的精神变态行为令侦探不安。

entries.en: She recoiled from the nastiness of the filthy kitchen behind the café.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆后面厨房的污秽让她厌恶地退缩了。

entries.en: A bright splotch of blue paint marked the corner of his sleeve.
entries.zh: 他的袖角上有一块鲜亮的蓝色油漆斑。

entries.en: The beekeeper checked the hives while the orchard filled with spring blossoms.
entries.zh: 果园春花盛开时，养蜂人检查了蜂箱。

entries.en: Her grandmother remained a fount of stories about the old neighborhood.
entries.zh: 她的祖母始终是讲述老街区故事的宝库。

entries.en: The actor gave the villain a fiendish laugh and a sweeping black cloak.
entries.zh: 演员赋予反派一阵恶魔般的笑声，并披上了宽大的黑斗篷。

entries.en: The neighbors greeted each other familiarly as they met by the gate.
entries.zh: 邻居们在门边遇见时，亲切随意地互相打招呼。

entries.en: The theater's techie fixed the microphone before the audience entered.
entries.zh: 剧院的技术人员在观众入场前修好了麦克风。

entries.en: A rose-colored afterglow lingered above the hills after the sun disappeared.
entries.zh: 太阳消失后，玫瑰色的晚霞仍停留在山丘上方。

entries.en: The teacher asked us to describe concretely how the machine worked.
entries.zh: 老师让我们具体描述这台机器如何运转。

entries.en: His disarmingly honest reply turned the tense interview into a friendly conversation.
entries.zh: 他坦诚得让人放下戒心的回答，使紧张的面试变成了友好的交谈。

entries.en: She smiled coyly when her friends asked who had sent the flowers.
entries.zh: 朋友们问是谁送的花时，她羞怯地笑了笑。

entries.en: A yellow buttercup grew between two stones beside the garden path.
entries.zh: 花园小路旁的两块石头之间长着一株黄色毛茛。

entries.en: The speedboat left a white trail across the calm blue bay.
entries.zh: 高速游艇在平静的蓝色海湾划出了一道白色尾迹。

entries.en: The art studio offers printmaking classes using woodblocks and copper plates.
entries.zh: 这家艺术工作室开设使用木版和铜版的版画制作课程。

entries.en: The photogenic harbor appeared on nearly every postcard sold in town.
entries.zh: 这个很上镜的港口几乎出现在镇上出售的每一张明信片上。

entries.meaningZh: 初次进入社交界的年轻女子
entries.en: The historical drama follows a debutante attending her first formal ball.
entries.zh: 这部历史剧讲述一位初入社交界的年轻女子参加第一次正式舞会的故事。

entries.en: The label specified that the sample contained undiluted orange juice.
entries.zh: 标签注明该样本装的是未稀释的橙汁。

entries.en: The review's hyperbolic praise made an ordinary performance sound like a miracle.
entries.zh: 评论中的夸张赞美把一场普通演出说得像奇迹一样。

entries.en: The empty playground added poignancy to the film's final scene.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的游乐场给电影最后一幕增添了辛酸的意味。

entries.en: Rainwater rushed through the culvert beneath the narrow country road.
entries.zh: 雨水从狭窄乡间公路下方的涵洞中急流而过。

entries.en: The library welcomed its thousandth visitor of the week on Friday afternoon.
entries.zh: 星期五下午，图书馆迎来了本周第一千位访客。

entries.en: The sepia photograph showed her grandparents standing outside their first home.
entries.zh: 那张深褐色的老照片中，祖父母站在他们第一所房子外面。

entries.en: The laboratory log recorded tests of the equipment's sterility before the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验室日志记录了实验前对设备无菌状态所做的检测。

entries.en: His opening pleasantry drew a gentle laugh from the tired audience.
entries.zh: 他开场的一句玩笑话让疲惫的观众轻轻笑了起来。

entries.en: The brass band assembled on the bandstand in the public gardens.
entries.zh: 铜管乐队在公园的露天音乐台上集合。

entries.en: The editor judiciously shortened the introduction without losing its central argument.
entries.zh: 编辑审慎地缩短了引言，同时保留了中心论点。

entries.en: Our choices are inescapably shaped by the circumstances in which we live.
entries.zh: 我们的选择不可避免地受到生活环境的影响。

entries.en: He adopted a professorial tone while explaining the rules of the game.
entries.zh: 解释游戏规则时，他摆出了一副教授般的口吻。

entries.en: The essay criticizes formalism that values perfect paperwork over useful results.
entries.zh: 这篇文章批评了重视完美文书而轻视实际成果的形式主义。

entries.en: She looked dubiously at the wobbly chair before deciding to stand.
entries.zh: 她怀疑地看了看那把摇晃的椅子，决定还是站着。

entries.en: The article was factually accurate even though its tone seemed unfair.
entries.zh: 这篇文章虽然语气显得不公，但事实叙述准确。

entries.en: We bought the same washing powder more cheaply at a nearby discounter.
entries.zh: 我们在附近一家折扣店以更低的价格买到了同样的洗衣粉。

entries.en: The project needed a practical doer who could turn plans into action.
entries.zh: 这个项目需要一位能把计划付诸行动的实干家。

entries.en: The path crossed a treeless plateau before descending toward the forest.
entries.zh: 小路穿过一片没有树木的高原，然后向森林方向下降。

entries.meaningZh: （文学用语，常用于woe betide）降临于
entries.en: Woe betide anyone who leaves muddy boots on the freshly polished floor.
entries.zh: 谁要是把泥靴子留在刚擦亮的地板上，就要倒霉了。

entries.en: A rowan heavy with red berries stood beside the stone cottage.
entries.zh: 一棵挂满红色浆果的花楸树立在石屋旁。

entries.en: The sylvan setting gave the outdoor concert a peaceful, secluded atmosphere.
entries.zh: 林间环境为这场户外音乐会营造了宁静幽僻的氛围。

entries.en: The farmer lifted a forkful of hay with a long wooden pitchfork.
entries.zh: 农夫用一把长木柄干草叉挑起了一叉干草。

entries.en: The theoretician developed a model that later researchers tested in the laboratory.
entries.zh: 这位理论家建立了一个模型，后来的研究者在实验室中对其进行了检验。

entries.en: The little dog had pointed ears and a narrow, foxy face.
entries.zh: 那只小狗有尖耳朵和一张像狐狸的窄脸。

entries.en: The chemistry textbook gives sulphurous acid as an example in this chapter.
entries.zh: 这本化学教材在本章中以亚硫酸为例。

entries.en: In the legend, a priest arrives to exorcize the spirit haunting the tower.
entries.zh: 传说中，一位神父前来驱除在塔中作祟的幽灵。

entries.en: The tall hedges preserved the separateness of the two neighboring gardens.
entries.zh: 高高的树篱让相邻的两个花园保持着相互分开的状态。

entries.meaningZh: 不信神的；无神的；另有贬义用法
entries.en: The philosopher imagined a godless universe governed entirely by natural processes.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家设想了一个完全由自然过程支配的无神宇宙。

entries.en: The shop sold mostly cheap grunge that broke after a few uses.
entries.zh: 这家店卖的大多是用几次就坏的廉价蹩脚货。

entries.en: The fibres formed a coherently bonded layer beneath the outer surface.
entries.zh: 纤维在外表层下面形成了一个结合成一体的层。

entries.en: The team's unexpected defeat chastened the captain and curbed his boasting.
entries.zh: 球队意外失利给了队长一个教训，使他不再那么吹嘘。

entries.en: The painted backcloth showed a village street beneath a cloudy sky.
entries.zh: 彩绘背景幕上是一条阴天下的村庄街道。

entries.en: The flatness of the plain made the distant hills look unusually dramatic.
entries.zh: 平原的平坦使远处的山丘显得格外壮观。

entries.en: She carried an armful of clean towels upstairs to the guest room.
entries.zh: 她抱着一大抱干净毛巾，上楼送到客房。

entries.en: Please do not misconstrue my silence as agreement with the proposal.
entries.zh: 请不要把我的沉默误解为赞同这项提议。

entries.en: The two churches are architecturally similar despite being built a century apart.
entries.zh: 这两座教堂虽然建造时间相隔一个世纪，但在建筑上很相似。

entries.en: The befuddled traveler studied the map upside down for several minutes.
entries.zh: 那位糊里糊涂的旅人把地图拿倒，研究了好几分钟。

entries.en: He arrived tired and unshaven after spending the night on a train.
entries.zh: 在火车上过了一夜后，他疲惫地到达，胡子也没刮。

entries.en: The research center opened a new laboratory devoted to plant genomics.
entries.zh: 研究中心开设了一个专门研究植物基因组学的新实验室。

entries.en: The café's shitty sound system made every song crackle and distort.
entries.zh: 咖啡馆那套烂音响让每首歌都噼啪作响、声音失真。

entries.en: She left the spare keys with her neighbor for safekeeping.
entries.zh: 她把备用钥匙交给邻居妥善保管。

entries.en: The honey extractor spun the frames to remove honey from the combs.
entries.zh: 蜂蜜分离器旋转巢框，把蜂蜜从蜂巢中分离出来。

entries.en: She accepted a professorship at the university where she had once studied.
entries.zh: 她接受了自己曾就读大学的教授职位。

entries.en: The audience nodded appreciatively as the young musician finished her solo.
entries.zh: 年轻乐手结束独奏时，观众赞赏地点头。

entries.en: The church archive contains baptismal records dating back more than two centuries.
entries.zh: 教堂档案中保存着可追溯到两个多世纪前的洗礼记录。

entries.en: The medical dictionary includes a diagram beside its entry on thrombosis.
entries.zh: 这本医学词典在血栓形成词条旁配有一张示意图。

entries.en: The library catalog lists several introductory books on chiropractic and its history.
entries.zh: 图书馆目录列出了几本介绍脊柱推拿疗法及其历史的入门书。

entries.en: She gamely continued the hike despite the rain soaking her boots.
entries.zh: 尽管雨水浸透了靴子，她仍顽强地继续徒步。

entries.en: Despite the early start, he sounded remarkably chipper on the phone.
entries.zh: 虽然一大早就出发了，他在电话里听起来却精神格外好。

entries.en: As inheritor of the family workshop, she preserved its traditional carving techniques.
entries.zh: 作为家族作坊的继承人，她保留了传统的雕刻技法。

entries.en: The museum displayed old posters promoting inoculation during a historical public campaign.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了昔日公共宣传活动中鼓励接种的旧海报。

entries.en: A polished wooden handrail ran along the entire length of the staircase.
entries.zh: 一根光滑的木扶手沿着整段楼梯延伸。

entries.en: The children watched in wonderment as the enormous balloon slowly rose.
entries.zh: 巨大的气球缓缓升起，孩子们惊叹地望着。

entries.en: The camera captured a wildcat moving along the edge of the forest.
entries.zh: 摄像机拍到了一只野猫沿着森林边缘行走。

entries.en: She stretched out on the divan beneath the sitting-room window.
entries.zh: 她在客厅窗下的长榻上舒展身体躺了下来。

entries.en: The technician used a caliper to measure the diameter of the pipe.
entries.zh: 技术员用卡钳测量了管子的直径。

entries.en: The historical chemistry display included a sealed bottle labeled chloroform.
entries.zh: 这个化学史展览展出了一只标有氯仿的密封瓶。

entries.en: Rapid development urbanized the valley and replaced many fields with apartment blocks.
entries.zh: 快速开发使山谷城市化，许多田地被公寓楼取代。

entries.meaningZh: 严守纪律的人；严格执行纪律者
entries.en: The headteacher was a firm disciplinarian who expected everyone to arrive punctually.
entries.zh: 校长严格执行纪律，要求所有人准时到达。

entries.meaningZh: （非正式；另有性用法）匆匆完成的；简短的
entries.en: The magazine published a quickie interview recorded backstage after the concert.
entries.zh: 杂志刊登了一次音乐会后在后台匆忙录制的简短采访。

entries.en: The late-night infomercial promised that its pan would never need scrubbing.
entries.zh: 这则深夜电视专题广告声称，它推销的锅永远不需要用力刷洗。

entries.meaningZh: 复式公寓；两层的公寓套房
entries.en: Their maisonette has a small kitchen downstairs and two bedrooms above.
entries.zh: 他们的复式公寓楼下有一个小厨房，楼上有两间卧室。

entries.en: A hollow in the rock provided a useful handhold for the climber.
entries.zh: 岩石上的一个凹洞为攀登者提供了一个好用的抓握点。

entries.en: The clay's plasticity allowed the sculptor to shape its surface easily.
entries.zh: 黏土的可塑性让雕塑家能轻松塑造它的表面。

entries.meaningZh: 继承亡夫爵位或财产的贵妇
entries.en: The dowager retained her title and continued to live at the family estate.
entries.zh: 这位遗孀保留了头衔，继续住在家族庄园里。

entries.en: Six sectoral pieces fit together to form the circular wooden pattern.
entries.zh: 六块扇形木片拼在一起，组成了圆形图案。
